tasks.task: Find link-worthy asset ideas for a niche

items.when: When a business has data, know-how or a local angle and needs three to five ideas editors would cover
When the product seems dull, to get product and story angles ranked by effort
When a calculator or small tool may earn more links than an article
Before choosing an idea, to see what the niche has argued about in recent weeks

tasks.task: Test an asset headline before anyone builds it

items.when: Before building a study, tool or guide, to judge whether an editor would cover it
When the working headline is weak, to get several honest angles to test
When you can run a small test, to sort the headlines and set the rule for a winner
When the headline states a topic and you need to find what actually happened and why it matters

tasks.task: Build a data study or survey story for the press

items.when: Before a survey goes out, to fix leading questions and plan a pretest
When the client has a dataset and you need the trends and comparisons worth a headline
When the analysis is done, to rank the findings by how strong and sure each one is
When a finding needs one clean chart a journalist can lift
When the study needs a plain how-we-did-this note with its limits
Before any number goes in a pitch, to check the method, the sums and any bias
When a striking number needs slowing down: what it counts and what it is compared with

tasks.task: Write the asset page: guide, statistics page or tool

items.when: When the asset is a guide or report, to set an outline that avoids padding
When the asset is a calculator, to design one that gives a real answer
When the findings need a single shareable graphic with a layout that fits them
When the page title is not settled, to compare several angles
When the page should also be cited by AI answers, to get the edits that help
Before publishing, to test each statistic for weak evidence and bias
Before the page is pitched, to trace every statistic on it to a dated source a journalist could check

tasks.task: Set target rules and score a prospect list

items.when: When you have a pasted list of sites or a gap export and need pitch, maybe and skip
When you want to add the sites AI tools keep citing for the buyer's questions
When the list chases authority scores and you should ask where the audience really reads

tasks.task: Build a prospect and media list

items.when: When you know the rivals, to get the link gap, a monthly quota and earned-link targets
When you start from the site alone and need places that could link or mention it
When the campaign has news, to get a media list and a press kit outline
When the asset is a guide, to plan who to contact and a personal note for each type
When you have the site and the role and need the right person's work email

tasks.task: Write a pitch email pack for one campaign

items.when: When the list is approved and you need the main pitch, two angle versions and one follow-up
When the story could go several ways, to get key messages and media pitch angles
When each email must sound like the sender and point to something specific on the site
When the pitch is written, to compare subject lines an editor would open
Before sending, to test each claim, check the legal basics and tighten the email

tasks.task: Run a digital PR campaign from idea to coverage

items.when: When the client wants links to a page that matters or has data worth sharing
When there is no plan yet, to set the mix of PR, mentions and listings
When the campaign rides a launch, to find the one idea the press could own
When the campaign needs a press release with headline options
Before the release goes out, to answer the hard questions a reporter will ask

tasks.task: Answer journalist requests for expert comment

items.when: When a reporter asks for sources on a topic the business truly knows
When many requests arrive, to rank which to answer and keep a win-rate sheet
When the quote is correct but flat, to get three versions worth printing
Before the answer is sent, to check every fact the expert states

tasks.task: Reclaim unlinked mentions

items.when: Every week or two, alongside campaigns, to work through mentions and dead links
When a page names the business without a link and you want to ask politely once
When you need the places that name the brand gathered into one list first
Before the request goes, to keep it short, true and easy to say yes to

tasks.task: Pitch a replacement for a broken link

items.when: When a relevant page links to a dead resource and your page truly covers the same thing
When broken link work should run on a steady rhythm, not as a one-off
Before sending, to check the claim that your page matches what the dead one covered

tasks.task: Audit the backlink profile and judge the risk

items.when: When bad links are suspected and you want a calm read before anyone touches disavow
When a backlink tool is connected, to get anchor spread, toxic links and lost links
When rankings fell, to see which pages lost clicks before blaming links
When an agency promises links, to read its proposal for red flags

tasks.task: Compare links with rivals and find the gap

items.when: When you need search overlap, content depth and backlinks side by side
When the gap must become a monthly target and a pitch list
When you need to know what the leading sites do that earns them links

tasks.task: Write the monthly link report

items.when: In the first week of each month, to review links won, lost and still in play
When you have the tool export, the tracking sheet and Search Console reports to hand
When the report should show non-brand clicks against the last period
When the month's Search Console export is in, to see which pages to push next
When you need a saved baseline so later slips in rankings or pages are noticed

tasks.task: Check a paid placement or guest post offer

items.when: When someone offers a sponsored article, link insertion or listing for money or product
When a sponsorship may be worth it for the audience and you need the cost and fit compared

tasks.task: Write a guest article or expert byline

items.when: When the editor has agreed a topic, to outline the piece before writing
When the outline is set and the article needs a draft with a strong opening
When the editor wants title choices, to offer several angles
Before sending to an editor, to find wording that reads as machine-written

tasks.task: Earn local links, listings and sponsorship mentions

items.when: When the business is missing from directories that matter, with listing text to submit
When name, address and phone differ across listings and need a fix list
When a nearby business or group could run a joint piece that earns a mention
When a local sponsorship is on offer, to weigh cost against audience fit

tasks.task: Pitch podcasts, newsletters and partners

items.when: When the founder is the guest, to settle what they should be known for
When each host needs a personal note tied to a recent episode or issue
When the note is drafted, to try several subject lines
Before sending, to test the claims and cut the note down

tasks.task: Point internal links at the pages that earn links

items.when: When earned links land on one page and should pass on to the pages that sell
When assets sit alone and need a hub with pillar and supporting pages
When you must choose which pages to push this month

tasks.task: Win mentions on the sites AI answers cite

items.when: When you have five buyer questions and want the cited sites ranked with who to contact
When you need to know if the main AI tools name the client or a rival
When the client's own page should be the one that gets cited

tasks.task: Set up outreach sending and batches

items.when: When outreach runs in batches and each should learn from the last one's results
Before the first batch, to score the sending set-up and DNS records
When pitches land in spam and the sending domain needs fixing
When you need to read a target site and its recent pieces with sources to cite

always.when: Before any pitch, release or asset goes out, to check each claim against trusted sources
Before an email or article is sent to an editor, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When the story needs press relationships, an embargo or a spokesperson prepared
When link targets depend on a keyword plan, a technical fix or a ranking drop
When the asset is a long guide or report that needs writing in full
When the study needs a large dataset cleaned and analysed
When the findings need charts or an interactive graphic editors can embed
When the goal is to be named in AI answers, not only to earn links

gaps: No library item scores a site as a link target: real readers, editorial standards and signs of link selling; only the kit does
No library item finds unlinked mentions or dead outbound links on target pages; the mention tracker gathers reviews and mentions only
No library item reads the Search Console Links and Manual Actions reports or decides whether a disavow file is needed
No library item turns a backlink tool export into links won, links lost and what each is worth
No library item builds an outreach tracking sheet or reads reply and win rates by campaign
No library item plans reactive PR: watching the news and pitching expert comment within hours
No library item pitches a guest article or a podcast guest slot, or checks a site's contributor rules
No library item checks a paid link for the right link attributes and disclosure; only the kit prompt does
No library item plans a press data study from public data with regional cuts and a ranked findings table
